about: The shared vector of session directory names (DS-33 to DS-37 in BEHAVIORS.md): the launcher's in_unit_form and role_grants.names_of read this one list under this one unit block and must give each name the verdict below. split is [ticket, slug] for a <ticket>-<slug> name, "whole" for a name slug_regex matches whole (accepted with no split), null for a rejected name. Each verdict is in_unit_form's reading: TICKET_FORM first, then slug_regex whole, then the first hyphen from the left whose halves match ticket_regex and slug_regex, every pattern read as POSIX ERE.

names.name: SMPL-482-x
names.why: the first hyphen leaves SMPL, which ticket_regex refuses; the second gives SMPL-482 and x

names.name: SMPL-482-7-x
names.why: the second and the third hyphen both give halves the two patterns accept; the first from the left wins

names.name: smpl-482-x
names.why: slug_regex matches the whole name, so it is accepted before any split, though smpl-482 and x would split

names.name: SMPL-482-7--8
names.why: only the bracket expression [[:digit:]-] accepts 7--8: POSIX ERE reads it as a digit or a hyphen, Python re as a set of '[', ':', 'd', 'i', 'g', 't' followed by the literal text '-]'
TICKET_FORM refuses a leading hyphen before slug_regex, whose second branch would accept it, is read

names.name: SMPL482
names.why: no hyphen to split at, and slug_regex refuses the whole name

names.name: SMPL-x
names.why: the only hyphen leaves SMPL, which ticket_regex refuses

names.name: SMPL-482-
names.why: the last hyphen leaves an empty slug, which slug_regex refuses

names.name: SMPL-482-X
names.why: the slug half X is upper case, which slug_regex refuses
